# Gagan Mobile Hospital

> Mobile phone repair shop in Patiala, Punjab, India. Walk-in repairs and pan-India post repair service.

## About

Gagan Mobile Hospital is a trusted mobile phone repair shop located at Village Baran, Sirhand Road, Patiala, Punjab – 147004, near Reliance Pump, opposite Sonu Sweets, Leela Bhawan.

Contact: +91 98140 36114
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919814036114

## Services

- Screen replacement (all brands and models)
- Battery replacement
- Charging port repair
- Camera repair
- Back glass replacement
- Water damage repair
- Software issues / flashing
- Speaker and microphone repair

## Brands serviced

Apple (iPhone), Samsung, OnePlus, Google Pixel, Xiaomi, Redmi, Realme, OPPO, Vivo, Motorola, Nokia, Nothing, Poco, iQOO, Tecno

## How it works

**Walk-in:** Visit our Patiala shop. Most repairs done in 90 minutes while you wait.

**Send by post (pan-India):** Speed Post your phone to us. We repair and return in 4–6 days. Cash on delivery on return — no upfront payment required.

## Policies

- No fix, no fee: if we cannot repair your device, we return it with a full diagnostic report at no charge
- Warranty: 6 months on all replaced parts
- Data privacy: customer phone numbers used only for repair callbacks; never shared or used for marketing
- Post repair: we pay return courier on every repair

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: How long does a walk-in repair take?**
A: Most repairs (screen, battery, charging port) are done in 90 minutes while you wait. Water damage and complex issues may take 1–2 days.

**Q: Can I send my phone from another city?**
A: Yes. Speed Post your phone to us from anywhere in India. We repair it and return it cash on delivery in 4–6 days.

**Q: Do you use genuine parts?**
A: OEM-grade parts for all repairs. For Apple, Samsung, and OnePlus screens we offer two grades with different price points — both carry a 6-month warranty.

**Q: What if you can't fix my phone?**
A: No fix, no fee. We return the phone free with a full diagnostic report.

**Q: Do you offer pickup in Patiala?**
A: Yes. Within Patiala city, our courier can pick up and drop your phone free of charge.

**Q: How do I book a repair?**
A: Use the booking form on the website, call +91 98140 36114, or WhatsApp us. We call back within 15 minutes to confirm.
